page_title: SOU 0-5 BRE | Southampton v Brentford 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' 0 - 5 Goal! The ball breaks to Yoane Wissa (Brentford) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 0:5.
90+2' 0 - 4 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo tees up Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 0:4.
90+1' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
89' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:2.
87' Adam Lallana (Southampton) comes onto the pitch because Joe Aribo simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
85' The game is interrupted now, Joe Aribo (Southampton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' The corner is swung in but Southampton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' The ball is cleared after Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Southampton.
81' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Christian Norgaard is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
81' Here's the change. Kevin Schade leaves the pitch and Paris Maghoma (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
80' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
79' A pass from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) is intercepted by Aaron Ramsdale and the move breaks down.
78' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
77' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
76' The total number of attempts is 6:16.
74' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
72' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save. He should have scored that.
71' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mathias Jensen as he is replaced by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford).
69' 0 - 3 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Aaron Ramsdale.
69' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' Referee Stuart Attwell is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Brentford!
68' Celebrations by Brentford are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
67' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Brentford!
66' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Aaron Ramsdale has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Yoane Wissa laid the ball off to Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
60' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar.
58' Brentford are seeing far more of the ball now.
55' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cameron Archer (Southampton) replacing Kamaldeen Sulemana.
55' We are about to witness a substitution. Adam Armstrong (Southampton) is replacing Paul Onuachu.
55' Celebrations are cut short for Brentford as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
55' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Brentford players aren’t happy.

53' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Bryan Mbeumo. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:2.
53' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner.
52' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
52' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner but it's cleared.
51' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.

50' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul.
48' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Ivan Juric has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) comes on the pitch for James Bree.
46' The game is over for Nathan Wood (Southampton). Charlie Taylor comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
42' A spell of possession for Southampton in an attempt to control the game.
40' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

38' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed to the left side of the goal, Mark Flekken didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
35' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
34' Dangerous play by Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:6.
27' That was close. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
25' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Aaron Ramsdale easily catches the ball.
23' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it.
22' What was Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
20' Joe Aribo (Southampton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Joe Aribo (Southampton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
15' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
14' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is adjudged offside.
11' Some neat passing and movement from Southampton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
8' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' 0 - 1 Kevin Schade (Brentford) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Southampton will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
